qualification: Reserving is free and holds the name on every ending listed in mail-reservations.json (inbox.day, blnc.day and blancmail.me since November 19, 2026) until Blanc Mail addresses open, as the reserve page says; claiming one later needs a paid plan, which the reserve page states beside its button.
